levels.surface: محمد بن سليمان بن هشام البغدادي

notes: the two taḥwīl branches («ح») are two groups; «قالا حدثنا سفيان» is the shared tail that both branches write once
the saying is Ibn Abbas relaying the Prophet's words: the Prophet is the end of the chain
«وهذا حديث وكيع» and «أو قال إسماعيل ويعقوب» are remarks on wording, not routes
